newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on increased activity.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on increased activity.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended with marginal gains as underlying firm fundamentals prompted support. Shortcovering by commisssion houses and switching of positions were the main activity. March futures broke the 1,250 level and rose to 1,252 before hovering at 1,247-1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures trend and trading continued slow with interest confined to nearby crude palm oil.
"We feel that fundamentals are good and we are waiting for export estimates for the whole of December from Caleb Brett and SGS," a dealer said.
Cargo surveyors SGS (M) Sdn Bhd and Caleb Brett are expected to release the December export data on January 2. The market is closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday.
Technically, the market appears steady, traders said.
"It (March futures) did try and test 1,250 ringgit and was traded briefly to 1,252 ringgit but it slipped slightly to hover steadily at around 1,245 to 1,248," another trader said.
March futures closed five ringgit higher at 1,246 ringgit ($492.88) a tonne after trading in a 10-ringgit range.
Traders said the next resistance will be 1,255 ringgit with strong support seen at 1,240.
Among physical, Jan (south) saw offers at 1,285 ringgit against bids at 1,275, after trading at 1,275 and 1,280. Jan (central) was offered at 1,265 and bids at 1,260.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,285 with bids at 1,275, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,265 and bids at 1,257.50.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $535 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Feb/Mar at $535 and Apr/May/Jun at $532.50. Jan was traded at $536.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $570, Feb/Mar at $567.50 and Apr/May/June at $557.50.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $407.50 and Feb/Mar at $410. Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
